description.en: Mecha Collection Kamen Rider Series 4th Battle Hopper & Shadow Moon is here!

description.ja: • メカコレならではの精密ディテールでバトルホッパーを忠実再現！
description.en: • Battle hopper is faithfully reproduced with precision details unique to mechanical collection!

description.ja: • 水転写式デカールでマシンのマーキングを再現！
description.en: • Reproduce the markings of the machine with water transfer decals!

description.ja: • バトルホッパーに跨るシャドームーンも単色成形で付属！ライダーベルトやマスクはもちろんの事エルボートリガーも忠実に再現。
description.en: • Shadow Moon that straddles the battle hopper is also included in single color molding! Not only the rider belt and mask, but also the elbow trigger are faithfully reproduced.

description.ja: • 発売済みの仮面ライダーBLACKと並べて仮面ライダーワールドが展開可能！
description.en: • Kamen Rider World can be developed alongside the released Kamen Rider BLACK!

description.ja: • パッケージは裏返すことで簡単にディスプレイ台座に変身！
description.en: • Easily transform the package into a display pedestal by flipping it over!
